scope: SM120 BF16-input E4M3 W8A16 shared-expert kernel-call comparison against cuTile, H2048/I512/E512/K10. This uses the native-comparison generator, separate from the original-versus-expanded Frost ablation cohort. Do not multiply speedups between cohorts.
retention: All selection candidate medians and reference errors, 16 frozen ABBA interval medians/reference errors, selected tactics, A/A ratios, and warm event control. Individual CUPTI samples are not duplicated here.

cases.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
cases.scope: BF16 input + routed FC1/activation + FC2/combine, identical per-expert E4M3 weights and FP32 scales; host/preparation/routing network/shared experts/communication/serving excluded
cases.numerical_contract: BF16 inputs, E4M3 weights with per-expert FP32 scales, FP32 dot accumulation, BF16 FC1 preactivation and activation, BF16 expert outputs and FP32 weighted combine; same reference for both.
cases.timer: CUPTI single-call first-to-last GPU activity span
cases.native_search: All advertised stage pairs across all supported native block sizes, gather and supported sorted modes, plus factorized shortlist and default
